description: Company / business enrichment lookup (US). Give a business name and a city or ZIP; get the best matching business with address, phone, website, social links, category, website health score, services it publishes on its own site, and a verification block: every field lists its sources and fetched-at date, sources are cross-checked (phone, name, address), conflicts are reported, and an overall confidence is given. Charged only when a match is found. Costs $0.03 per call (x402).
